d:
Presenting TERE SIVA KAUN HAI MERA FULL VIDEO SONG from AATANK HI AATANK movie starring Rajinikanth, Aamir Khan, Juhi Chawla, Archana Joglekar in lead roles, released in 1995. The song is sung by Sadhana Sargam and music is given by Bappi Lahiri, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: TERE SIVA KAUN HAI MERA
Singer: SADHANA SARGAM
Music Director: BAPPI LAHIRI
Lyricist: NAQSH LYALLPURI, ANWAR SAGAR
When the film was originally announced (as Aatank) it starred Sunny Deol and 'Rajnikant' in lead roles.
Realesed on 4th August 1995, on the same day as Hulchul and Crimnal
